text:
Maya (People Ops): quick sync  candidate: Priyanka Rao. Hiring requests comp-band exception + staggered start benefits because shes finishing a contract and can only be in-office part-time for first month. Manager wants L5->L6 provisional, benefits day 1 or bridging stipend. Packet: https://redwood-internal/hr/offers/priyanka-rao
Liam (Hiring Manager): +1. Priyanka leads the optimizer project. If we lose her to counteroffer, timeline slips 3 months. Proposed provisional base $185k -> $205k. Sign-on $15k (50/50 split). Start target: 2026-07-12 but part-time until 2026-08-12.
Sofia (Recruiter): candidate verbally accepted subject to offer + benefits. Shes flexible on the sign-on cadence. Concern: benefits enrollment with part-time first month.
Harpreet (Finance): need GL, budget owner, and exact uplift delta. Anything >$15k uplift needs comp-committee signoff. Also confirm whether sign-on is cash vs stipend.
Maya (People Ops): numbers below:
```
Current band (L5): $185,000
Requested provisional (L6): $205,000 (+$20k)
Sign-on: $15,000 (cash, 50% at start, 50% at 6 months)
Relocation: none
Start: 2026-07-12 (part-time first 4 weeks; full-time 2026-08-12)
Benefits requested: effective 07/12 (or bridging stipend if not possible)
Rationale: critical infra ownership and immediate cross-team onboarding required
```
Harpreet (Finance): GL: 6101.1400, budget owner: eng-platform. Can provision pending comp-committee and Legal. Clarify part-time payroll classification for month 1.
CompCommittee (Comp Committee): please attach manager justification and 2-3 peer comps. We'll review for fast-track.
Maya (People Ops): uploaded manager note and comp matrix: https://redwood-internal/docs/comp/priyanka-matrix-2026.xlsx
Legal (Legal): for part-time initial month, recommend "benefits-bridging stipend" clause: if benefits can't be activated on day 1 due to payroll cutoff, company will pay a monthly stipend equal to the employee contribution amount. Template attached.
hr-bot: policy note: "Part-time first month exceptions require Comp Committee + Payroll coordination" (HR-PART-002). Template: /templates/parttime-bridging-stipend-v1.docx
Sofia (Recruiter): candidate confirmed theyd accept bridging stipend if needed.
Liam (Hiring Manager): can VP Eng sign provisional uplift if comp-committee OK? We need to close today.
CompCommittee (Comp Committee): scheduling review now. If docs complete we'll fast-track.
Harpreet (Finance): approved pending legal clause and comp sign-off.
Legal (Legal): signed off on bridging stipend language and added standard clawback: if employee voluntarily departs within 12 months, sign-on prorated repayment applies.
CompCommittee (Comp Committee): approved (fast-track) with note: provisional for 60 days, review at 45 days to confirm permanent placement or revert.
VP Eng (Nadia): I approve provisional uplift and part-time arrangement given business impact; agree to 60-day review.
Maya (People Ops): routing summary: comp-committee -> finance -> legal -> VP signoff completed. Offer to be sent at 17:00 PT. Sofia to confirm acceptance and return signed docs. :thumbsup:
Sofia (Recruiter): sending now. Will update thread when signed.
hr-bot: automated reminder scheduled: "Follow-up: confirm benefits activation and 60-day review" on 2026-09-10.
